'''Force Body''',<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> or '''Prolong Force''', was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]]-based [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|power]]. It allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to keep drawing on the Force past the point of exhaustion where they would not be able to use their abilities. However, this came at a cost, with the Force-sensitive suffering real, physical damage the longer the ability was used,<ref name="RPG-Core" /> and sometimes temporarily appearing withered.<ref>''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

A solid connection to the Force and physical durability were required for this ability's safe use. With this, Jedi could invoke more power than usual, but if used without care, this art might well [[Death/Legends|kill]] them.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
